insights: A submultiset t ≤ s is uniquely determined by its count function restricted to s.toFinset
Elements outside s.toFinset have count 0 in any submultiset, so no information is lost
The bijection {t // t ≤ s} ≃ ∀ a : ↑s.toFinset, Fin (s.count a + 1) is the key construction
Fintype.card_congr chains: {t // t ∈ distinctSubMultisets s} ≃ {t // t ≤ s} ≃ ∀ a, Fin (count a + 1)
Lean 4.26.0 requires explicit Fintype instances via Fintype.ofFinset; auto-synthesis fails for {t // t ∈ s}
Finset.prod_coe_sort requires exact form via exact not rw (beta reduction mismatch)
mathlibGaps: Fintype {t // t ∈ s} where s : Finset α is not auto-synthesized in 4.26.0 — must use Finset.attach explicitly
